idea: SaludData Peru se enfoca inicialmente en el talón de farmacia como puerta de entrada: los usuarios escanean sus boletas mediante OCR localizado que extrae medicamento, dosis, precio y farmacia, construyendo un historial digital de medicamentos. A partir de ahí, la app compara precios en farmacias cercanas y genera alertas de riesgos (interacciones, duplicidades) y recordatorios de reposición. Los datos agregados y anonimizados se monetizan con EPS y farmacias interesadas en patrones de adherencia y gasto real por zona, mientras el usuario accede gratis a su pasaporte de medicación.

_iteration_one_liner: We digitize Peruvian pharmacy receipts into a personal medication ledger, enabling price savings and health alerts, and sell anonymized adherence insights to insurers and pharmacies.

idea: SaludData Peru becomes a B2B data pipeline provider: an OCR API specialized in Peruvian pharmacy receipts (boletas) that automatically extracts medication names, dosages, patient IDs, and dates, structuring them into a normalized format for direct integration with EPS, clinic, or pharmacy chain systems. The platform aggregates real-time, anonymized medication usage patterns and adherence analytics, feeding risk models for chronic disease management. The buyer is the head of data or operations at a pharmacy chain or an EPS, who currently wastes thousands of dollars monthly on manual data entry and lacks visibility into patient medication behavior outside their walls.
